roles.title: Creative Director
roles.responsibility: Own the game's creative pillars, tone, target experience, and cross-discipline tradeoffs
acceptance: Every pillar maps to observable player experience
Conflicting changes receive an explicit decision

roles.title: Game Director
roles.responsibility: Own the integrated player experience and adjudicate gameplay, narrative, world, and pacing decisions
acceptance: Decisions reflect tested gameplay
Cross-team criteria have accountable owners

roles.title: Technical Director
roles.responsibility: Own engine architecture, platform limits, system contracts, technical budgets, and long-term maintainability
acceptance: Frozen ABI and ownership are explicit
New dependencies and platform costs are evaluated

roles.title: Art Director
roles.responsibility: Own visual language, references, asset quality bars, and coherent lighting and material direction
acceptance: Silhouette, readability, and visual consistency checked in game
Asset budgets reviewed with technical art

roles.title: Design Director
roles.responsibility: Own design pillars and consistency across combat, traversal, world, quests, and progression
acceptance: Contradictory mechanics resolved
Design intent is testable in playable slices

roles.title: Narrative Director
roles.responsibility: Own story themes, character arcs, canon, and alignment of interactive story with authored plot
acceptance: Quest and dialogue beats preserve continuity
Spoilers and branching consequences documented

roles.title: Audio Director
roles.responsibility: Own sonic identity, technical mixing standards, music direction, and gameplay audio priorities
acceptance: Critical combat cues remain intelligible
Runtime voice and memory budgets identified

roles.title: Animation Director
roles.responsibility: Own motion style, locomotion/combat expressiveness, retarget standards, and animation quality
acceptance: Every animation conveys timing and hit intent
Runtime budgets are approved

roles.title: Executive Producer
roles.responsibility: Own funding-level production scope, strategic milestones, staffing, and publisher commitments
acceptance: Milestone promises backed by dependency estimates
Changes surface cost and scope effects

roles.title: Lead Producer
roles.responsibility: Own day-to-day milestone delivery across departments and unblock dependencies
acceptance: Every task names an owner and test
Unfinished work cannot be marked complete

roles.title: Technical Producer
roles.responsibility: Coordinate engine/tooling deliveries, ABI gates, build dependencies, and integration sequence
acceptance: Parallel workers have non-overlapping writes
Blocking interface work is gated

roles.title: Production Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Keep task metadata, milestones, meeting decisions, assets, and handoffs traceable
acceptance: All deliverables link to baseline and responsible role
Blocked tasks show next action

roles.title: External Development Producer
roles.responsibility: Specify and accept outsourced art, audio, animation, and engineering deliverables
acceptance: Licensing and source formats accounted for
Outsourced work passes in-engine validation

roles.title: Lead Game Designer
roles.responsibility: Translate direction into coherent gameplay specifications and review systems for player-facing consistency
acceptance: Controls, feedback, and challenge requirements are unambiguous
Key interactions can be playtested

roles.title: Gameplay Designer
roles.responsibility: Design moment-to-moment player actions, feedback loops, affordances, and interaction rules
acceptance: Timing and state transitions are specified
Readable feedback exists for success and failure

roles.title: Combat Designer
roles.responsibility: Design attack-defend interactions, enemy telegraphs, difficulty, and damage risk-reward
acceptance: Parry, dodge, stagger and hit reactions are consistent
Enemy punish windows are measurable

roles.title: Player Movement Designer
roles.responsibility: Design traversal verbs, acceleration, air control, grappling, and movement readability
acceptance: Moves chain without contradictory controls
Traversal edge cases and recovery paths tested

roles.title: Weapons Designer
roles.responsibility: Design weapon archetypes, handling feel, damage profile, recoil, reload and alt-fire behaviors
acceptance: Archetypes have distinct roles
Animation and audio windows align with state machine

roles.title: Systems Designer
roles.responsibility: Define game-wide rules, resource loops, interactions and progression-facing systemic behaviors
acceptance: No circular progression dependency
Save and simulation ownership identified

roles.title: Progression Designer
roles.responsibility: Design ability unlocks, player power curves, choices and long-term pacing
acceptance: All unlocks have dependencies
Power spikes align with intended challenge

roles.title: Economy Designer
roles.responsibility: Design currencies, resource sinks and faucets, upgrade costs, and reward pacing
acceptance: Currencies avoid deadlocks and runaway inflation
Rewards fit session and chapter pacing

roles.title: AI Behavior Designer
roles.responsibility: Define enemy goals, senses, roles, group tactics, and readable behavior parameters
acceptance: Behavior data conforms to GOAP contracts
Transitions and perception have observable debug traces

roles.title: Level Designer
roles.responsibility: Shape navigable space, combat arenas, traversal routes, choke points and pacing
acceptance: Navigation is readable
Sightlines, cover and traversal match enemy and player capabilities

roles.title: World Designer
roles.responsibility: Structure interconnected regions, landmarks, world logic, exploration rewards, and discovery pacing
acceptance: Locations connect consistently
Streaming and level-of-detail boundaries are considered

roles.title: Encounter Designer
roles.responsibility: Arrange enemy compositions, spawn activation, cover, escalation and reward beats
acceptance: Encounters remain possible in all difficulty modes
AI pathing and player exits verified

roles.title: Quest Designer
roles.responsibility: Design RPG quest structure, states, branching outcomes, triggers and rewards
acceptance: Re-entry and save/load paths covered
Outcomes preserve narrative canon and progression

roles.title: Mission Designer
roles.responsibility: Build authored objective sequences, scripted situations, mission recovery, and pacing
acceptance: Objectives and checkpoint state remain recoverable
Scripts cannot soft-lock progression

roles.title: Technical Game Designer
roles.responsibility: Bridge data-driven design with editor tools, schemas, visual scripting, and runtime data
acceptance: Designers can author without code edits
Data rejects invalid references before runtime

roles.title: Balance Designer
roles.responsibility: Quantify combat, difficulty, player economy, scaling and game-feel tuning
acceptance: Claims come from simulations or playtests
Outliers and dominant strategies documented

roles.title: Accessibility Designer
roles.responsibility: Design configurable controls, visual/audio alternatives, readability and difficulty interfaces
acceptance: Alternatives maintain the same functional information
Options survive save and profile changes

roles.title: Narrative Designer
roles.responsibility: Make story react to player state, quests, environment, and gameplay outcomes
acceptance: All story beats have valid triggers
Branches preserve world and quest continuity

roles.title: Game Writer
roles.responsibility: Write dialogue, descriptions, character voices, quest text, and scene scripts
acceptance: Consistent terminology and voice
Lines fit trigger context and localization limits

roles.title: Lore and Worldbuilding Writer
roles.responsibility: Develop setting histories, factions, cultures, places, and in-world reference material
acceptance: Lore matches existing event timeline
Reader-facing exposition fits discovery pacing

roles.title: Dialogue Designer
roles.responsibility: Design conversational choices, branching lines, barks, and reactive VO events
acceptance: Conversations always resolve to a valid node
Repeated barks obey cooldown and interruption policy

roles.title: Cinematic Designer
roles.responsibility: Block interactive and noninteractive scenes, camera staging, timing, transitions, and skip behavior
acceptance: Player control handoffs are deterministic
Aspect ratio and camera collision tested

roles.title: Narrative Editor
roles.responsibility: Check consistency, voice, canon, clarity, pacing and readiness of game text
acceptance: All edits preserve identifiers and branches
Dialogue line revisions are tracked

roles.title: Storyboard Artist
roles.responsibility: Translate story beats into shot sequences, framing, transitions, and performance cues
acceptance: Every shot supports intent and spatial continuity
Cuts map to gameplay handoff points

roles.title: Lead Engineer
roles.responsibility: Translate technical direction into engineering contracts, reviews, and stable implementation boundaries
acceptance: Ownership and lifecycle explicit
Platform and performance risks escalated

roles.title: Engine Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement engine core, scene/runtime integration, lifecycle, memory and platform abstractions
acceptance: Object lifetime and ABI remain stable
Engine and editor startup verified

roles.title: Rendering Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement render passes, GPU resource management, shader compilation, framebuffers and visibility
acceptance: Measured GPU costs and memory
Rendering interfaces preserved
No unstated driver assumptions

roles.title: Gameplay Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement player mechanics, interaction state, inventory, abilities and world gameplay logic
acceptance: Controls and damage are deterministic under replay
Ownership of gameplay state documented

roles.title: Combat Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement hit detection, weapon state machines, damage, parries, stagger and combat response
acceptance: Timing matches design data
Combat remains valid under variable frame time

roles.title: AI Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement decision making, GOAP planning, perception, working memory and behavior debugging
acceptance: Plans reproduce from fixed inputs
Agent decisions and failures can be traced

roles.title: Navigation Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement pathfinding, navmesh streaming, traversal links and crowd movement
acceptance: Paths remain valid across streamed regions
Dynamic obstacles and off-mesh links tested

roles.title: Physics Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement collision queries, ragdolls, physics integration and deterministic collision behavior
acceptance: Hit and contact stability tested across FPS
Physics API isolation documented

roles.title: Animation Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement animation graphs, retargeting, IK, layering and runtime animation event dispatch
acceptance: Transition edge cases and frame pacing tested
Root motion contract unambiguous

roles.title: UI Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement menus, HUD, navigation, input focus, responsive layouts and settings binding
acceptance: Menu state survives resize and resume
Controller and keyboard pathways validated

roles.title: Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Build editor workflows, asset import tools, validators, profiling utilities and iteration tooling
acceptance: Invalid input fails with actionable message
Editor path validated with representative content

roles.title: World Streaming Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement region streaming, world partition, HLOD residency, asset paging and world visibility
acceptance: Peak memory and upload budgets measured
Region unload leaves no dangling references

roles.title: Memory Systems Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement allocators, virtual memory segments, lifetime tracing and container ownership
acceptance: Alignment and overflow tested
Hot-path allocations counted and bounded

roles.title: Audio Programmer
roles.responsibility: Integrate FMOD or other audio middleware, runtime event routing, streaming and DSP hooks
acceptance: Bank loading and unloading verified
Timing and event ownership documented

roles.title: Platform Programmer
roles.responsibility: Maintain OS and graphics backend integration, input devices, file I/O and deployment differences
acceptance: Platform behavior guarded by actual capability checks
Startup/shutdown passes tests

roles.title: Build Engineer
roles.responsibility: Maintain reproducible builds, compile configurations, dependency pinning and artifact provenance
acceptance: Clean checkout builds deterministically
Every artifact tracks source commit and configuration

roles.title: Integration Engineer
roles.responsibility: Integrate approved parallel branches, resolve source and ABI conflicts, run cumulative regression gates, and publish the authoritative code baseline
acceptance: All merge inputs identify the same ancestor
Merged builds and regression tests pass with provenance

roles.title: CI and DevOps Engineer
roles.responsibility: Automate builds, static analysis, tests, artifact storage, and failure triage
acceptance: Failures halt promotion
Build runners and caches produce traceable results

roles.title: Network Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement optional online features, lobby/session transport, replication and net diagnostics
acceptance: Offline game remains functional
Protocol versioning and failure states tested

roles.title: Performance Engineer
roles.responsibility: Investigate CPU, GPU, memory, I/O and threading bottlenecks using representative captures
acceptance: Methods and hardware documented
Improvement is measured and regressions highlighted

roles.title: Save and Serialization Programmer
roles.responsibility: Implement stable save schemas, migration, recovery, and deterministic state restoration
acceptance: Old saves migrate or fail gracefully
State integrity checked across streaming boundaries

roles.title: Concept Artist
roles.responsibility: Explore silhouettes, mood, costumes, props and location visual directions before production
acceptance: References and design intent are explicit
Silhouette reads at gameplay distance

roles.title: Character Artist
roles.responsibility: Create production-ready character sculpt, topology, textures, modular gear and LODs
acceptance: Topology supports deformation
Scale, texture channels and LOD budgets pass validation

roles.title: Creature Artist
roles.responsibility: Create enemy and creature geometry with anatomy, readability, rig requirements and variant structure
acceptance: Attack silhouettes remain readable
Rigging and hit regions are feasible

roles.title: Environment Artist
roles.responsibility: Build terrain, architecture, vegetation and modular world kits under gameplay and streaming budgets
acceptance: Kit snaps and variation work
Streaming, collisions and terrain seam issues checked

roles.title: Level Artist
roles.responsibility: Set dress authored spaces, improve compositions, storytelling props, occlusion and visual landmarks
acceptance: Gameplay routes remain readable
Art does not invalidate collision and enemy sightlines

roles.title: Prop Artist
roles.responsibility: Model and texture interactive and decorative objects for environments
acceptance: Pivot and scale correct
Breakable/interactable variants meet technical requirements

roles.title: Weapon Artist
roles.responsibility: Create weapon silhouettes, meshes, attachments, materials and animation-ready pivots
acceptance: Hands and attachment axes align
Sight picture and silhouette remain clear

roles.title: Material and Texture Artist
roles.responsibility: Create consistent surface materials, trim sheets, atlases and texture channel standards
acceptance: Texel density and color spaces consistent
GPU residency budgets accounted for

roles.title: Lighting Artist
roles.responsibility: Establish scene mood, focal hierarchy, readable contrast and performance-aware lighting
acceptance: Gameplay targets and paths remain readable
Lighting cost measured on target hardware

roles.title: UI Artist
roles.responsibility: Produce HUD, icons, menus and visual states consistent with game identity
acceptance: States are visually distinguishable
Assets scale at target resolutions

roles.title: 2D Illustration Artist
roles.responsibility: Create codex illustrations, maps, load-screen artwork, key art and narrative visuals
acceptance: Artwork fits diegetic context
Text-free exports and localization needs considered

roles.title: Procedural Environment Artist
roles.responsibility: Author rule-driven vegetation, rock scatter, terrain dressing and biome variants
acceptance: Reproduction from seeds
Biome boundaries and collision density validated

roles.title: Technical Art Director
roles.responsibility: Own art pipeline architecture, performance budgets, renderer-art compatibility and validation standards
acceptance: Producer workflows use reproducible exports
Memory and rendering constraints are explicit

roles.title: Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Bridge asset authoring and runtime through import rules, rigs, shaders, tools and performance tests
acceptance: Artists can reproduce workflow
Asset import exposes actionable errors

roles.title: Shader Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Implement and tune artist-authored materials, shader features, variants and look consistency
acceptance: Target look and fallback verified
Variant count and compilation impact measured

roles.title: Environment Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Engineer environment asset cooking, vegetation HLOD, terrain materials, scatter and scene optimization
acceptance: Cook results reproducible
Asset paging and editor previews agree

roles.title: Character Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Own character asset import, skinning compatibility, rigs, material and geometry budgets
acceptance: Skeletal naming and transforms stable
LOD swaps and deformation validated

roles.title: Procedural Tools Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Build artist-facing procedural generators, scatter recipes and repeatable asset transforms
acceptance: Deterministic output on fixed inputs
Artist override and undo supported

roles.title: VFX Artist
roles.responsibility: Design moment-to-moment combat, environment and cinematic effects with clear readability
acceptance: Critical effects preserve target visibility
Effects match timing and audio cues

roles.title: VFX Technical Artist
roles.responsibility: Implement performant VFX tools, GPU particles, simulation batching and effect profiling
acceptance: No unbounded emitters or allocations
Deterministic fallback for low settings

roles.title: Gameplay Animator
roles.responsibility: Animate locomotion, traversal, interactions and transitions for responsiveness
acceptance: Foot placement and loop transitions checked
Responsiveness survives animation blending

roles.title: Combat Animator
roles.responsibility: Animate attack tells, hit reactions, parries and weapon handling with readable windows
acceptance: Pose silhouettes readable
Contact events match combat state timing

roles.title: Creature Animator
roles.responsibility: Animate nonhuman locomotion, attack language, idles and creature reactions
acceptance: Anatomy and attack telegraphs consistent
Retarget and foot contact tested

roles.title: Cinematic Animator
roles.responsibility: Animate narrative performance, blocking, staging and camera-facing body motion
acceptance: Performance follows shot list
Blend in/out to gameplay tested

roles.title: Facial Animator
roles.responsibility: Animate expressions, speech and emotional beats for character performances
acceptance: Sync matches authored line timing
Face rigs handle extremes without deformation artifacts

roles.title: Character Rigger
roles.responsibility: Create skeletons, skin weights, IK controls and constraint-ready character rigs
acceptance: Skeleton contracts honored
Extreme poses show no critical skinning errors

roles.title: Technical Animator
roles.responsibility: Develop rig tooling, state integration, retargeting and animation optimization
acceptance: Pipeline replicable
Run-time skeleton and exporter agree

roles.title: Motion Capture Specialist
roles.responsibility: Plan, capture, clean and retarget actor performance recordings when capture hardware and footage exist
acceptance: Retarget and timestamp alignment measured
Missing raw footage is reported

roles.title: UI Motion Designer
roles.responsibility: Design interface transitions, feedback motion, easing and timings supporting clarity
acceptance: Input remains responsive
Reduced-motion route preserves information

roles.title: Sound Designer
roles.responsibility: Create and organize combat, traversal, environmental and interaction sound effects
acceptance: Critical game cues have priority
Looping and tails are seamless

roles.title: Technical Sound Designer
roles.responsibility: Bridge sound content to real-time middleware, parameter routing and adaptive systems
acceptance: Parameter changes and fallback states tested
Bank residency documented

roles.title: Audio Implementer
roles.responsibility: Hook authored sounds, dialogue and music to gameplay events and spatial emitters
acceptance: Events have validated trigger conditions
Occlusion and distance curves tested

roles.title: Music Composer
roles.responsibility: Create thematic score, motifs, cues and arrangements matching dramatic and gameplay structure
acceptance: Cue lengths and transitions accommodate gameplay
Rights and stems documented

roles.title: Interactive Music Designer
roles.responsibility: Design layered music states, combat intensity transitions, stingers and dynamic score logic
acceptance: No silent gaps on transitions
Intensity changes respond to game events

roles.title: Dialogue Editor
roles.responsibility: Prepare voice assets, edits, naming, line timing, localization-safe metadata and takes
acceptance: Lines align with stable IDs
No missing or mismatched takes in bank

roles.title: Audio Mixer
roles.responsibility: Balance dialogue, music, SFX, spatialization and dynamic range across play states
acceptance: Speech and combat cues remain audible
Output levels checked in representative scenes

roles.title: Voice Director
roles.responsibility: Specify acting intentions, line delivery context, takes, and recording session requirements
acceptance: Direction maps to scene context
No recorded performances are claimed without actual source

roles.title: UX Director
roles.responsibility: Own player information hierarchy, navigation consistency and interaction design quality
acceptance: Core actions discoverable without tutorial overload
Design validated by tests

roles.title: UX Designer
roles.responsibility: Design player flows, interaction affordances, settings discoverability and feedback semantics
acceptance: Control states have clear feedback
Critical flows work with keyboard and controller

roles.title: UI Designer
roles.responsibility: Structure HUD, menus, inventory, maps and interactive layouts
acceptance: Information priority survives different aspect ratios
Visual and focus states defined

roles.title: User Researcher
roles.responsibility: Plan playtests, observe behavior, analyze usability findings, and distinguish evidence from opinions
acceptance: Observation separated from inference
Sampling bias and limitations recorded

roles.title: Player Insights Analyst
roles.responsibility: Analyze telemetry, playtest funnels, retention and difficulty friction from instrumented sessions
acceptance: Events have stable semantics
Claims include denominator and sampling context

roles.title: QA Lead
roles.responsibility: Own test strategy, defect prioritization, coverage and release quality gates
acceptance: Bugs have reproducible steps and severity
No build is certified solely by assertion

roles.title: Functional QA Tester
roles.responsibility: Execute player flows, mechanics, saves, quests and regression scenarios
acceptance: Repro includes build and platform
Expected and actual behavior distinct

roles.title: Technical QA Analyst
roles.responsibility: Diagnose engine-level failures, logs, crashes, serialization, thread and GPU errors
acceptance: Root cause claims point to source/log evidence
Fix verified against exact build

roles.title: Automation QA Engineer
roles.responsibility: Develop deterministic automated tests for systems, tools and integration workflows
acceptance: Tests fail for known broken cases
Timeouts and flaky data tracked

roles.title: Performance QA Analyst
roles.responsibility: Run controlled benchmarks for frame time, memory, loading and streaming regressions
acceptance: Hardware and settings recorded
Variance reported and repeated samples compared

roles.title: Compatibility Tester
roles.responsibility: Test OS, graphics APIs, drivers, hardware and display configurations
acceptance: Test environment recorded
Crashes and rendering differences reproduced

roles.title: Accessibility Tester
roles.responsibility: Test remapping, visual readability, audio alternatives, focus order and reduced-motion behavior
acceptance: User settings actually work end to end
Alternative cues convey equivalent gameplay information

roles.title: Localization QA Tester
roles.responsibility: Test localized text rendering, subtitles, timing, fonts and language-context accuracy
acceptance: Placeholders and encoding render correctly
Branching dialogue stays linked to IDs

roles.title: Playtest Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Recruit and schedule representative testers, manage sessions, collect instrumentation and notes
acceptance: Sessions run against controlled builds
Privacy and consent requirements for people respected

roles.title: Release Manager
roles.responsibility: Own promotion from verified build to release candidate, storefront delivery and rollback plan
acceptance: All platform and build gates pass
Published binaries match tested hashes

roles.title: Certification Specialist
roles.responsibility: Audit platform requirements, store submissions, entitlement and platform compliance
acceptance: Requirements linked to current official platform docs
Waivers documented

roles.title: Localization Producer
roles.responsibility: Coordinate translation kits, glossary, schedules, language QA and localized deliveries
acceptance: String freeze and text IDs stable
Late source changes are re-exported

roles.title: Localization Specialist
roles.responsibility: Adapt dialogue, UI and marketing strings to locale while preserving game meaning
acceptance: Placeholders and gender/number logic valid
Wording fits UI limits

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.responsibility: Research target audience and market, prioritize player-facing value, positioning and release features
acceptance: Assumptions clearly sourced
Features have measurable user value

roles.title: Brand and Marketing Manager
roles.responsibility: Plan public positioning, audience outreach, creative campaign and storefront messaging
acceptance: Public claims match implemented game
Campaign material has asset and timing owner

roles.title: Community Manager
roles.responsibility: Manage community feedback channels, announcements, moderation plans and response synthesis
acceptance: Feedback reports separate frequency from severity
Communications align with actual release state

roles.title: Public Relations Manager
roles.responsibility: Coordinate press communication, review keys, media briefings and announcement accuracy
acceptance: Statements verifiable
Press assets reflect current build

roles.title: Marketing Capture Artist
roles.responsibility: Capture representative in-game footage and screenshots at controlled camera and render settings
acceptance: Shots reproducible from actual builds
Visual quality is disclosed when captured with special settings

roles.title: Trailer Editor
roles.responsibility: Construct trailer pacing, story beats, gameplay clarity and audio transitions from authentic footage
acceptance: Shots depict supported game features
Platform-safe audio and timing cuts validated

roles.title: Player Support Specialist
roles.responsibility: Document installation failures, known issues, crash reporting and player-facing solutions
acceptance: Steps validated for supported builds
Issue patterns link to reproducible bug reports

roles.title: Studio Operations Manager
roles.responsibility: Manage studio tooling accounts, access, storage, documentation policy and process continuity
acceptance: Access changes are auditable
Critical assets have backup and recovery path

roles.title: Finance and Budget Producer
roles.responsibility: Model development costs, contractor budgets, forecast scenarios and milestone runway
acceptance: Cost assumptions labeled
Committed and hypothetical expenses separated

roles.title: Vendor and Outsourcing Manager
roles.responsibility: Select and coordinate external vendors and ensure delivery compliance, rights and quality
acceptance: Source files and reuse rights documented
Acceptance tied to in-engine tests

roles.title: Business Development Manager
roles.responsibility: Assess publishers, licensing, partnerships, opportunities and commercial terms
acceptance: External claims evidence-backed
Commercial terms distinguished from assumptions

roles.title: Legal and Licensing Manager
roles.responsibility: Track software, art, audio, middleware, distribution licensing and IP contract requirements
acceptance: Licenses traced to components
Legal conclusions flagged for qualified review

roles.title: Documentation and Knowledge Manager
roles.responsibility: Maintain searchable design, engineering and production specifications with version histories
acceptance: Every active decision references an owner and version
Stale instructions identified

roles.title: Player Controller Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own player input arbitration, ground and aerial locomotion states, camera-relative control, and transitions to combat and traversal.
acceptance: Transitions survive repeated rapid inputs and frame-rate variation
No stuck states after death reload or chunk handoff
Debug trace exposes exact rejected transition reason.

roles.title: Ability Framework Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own reusable ability activation, cooldown, resource costs, stacking and modifier evaluation, excluding weapon-specific combat damage ownership.
acceptance: Stacking and exclusivity are deterministic
No double-cost or duplicate activation under spam
Saved ability state survives compatible migrations.

roles.title: Interaction Systems Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own contextual world interactions, targeting, usability predicates, and event dispatch between world objects and the player.
acceptance: No stale target survives streaming unload
Multiple candidate priority rules are reproducible
UI feedback matches accepted available interactions.

roles.title: Inventory and Equipment Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own item containers, stack rules, loadout slots, equip transactions and gameplay attachment links.
acceptance: No duplicated or lost items after interrupted transactions
Slot and attachment invariants hold after reload
Invalid item data fails gracefully and reports exact ID.

roles.title: Quest Runtime Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own quest state interpreter, trigger subscription, objective progression, save data and recovery paths, not quest writing.
acceptance: Every reachable quest state has a recovery or terminal path
No duplicate rewards or missed trigger on replay
State serializes and migrates by stable ID.

roles.title: Gameplay Scripting Integration Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own editor-authored C# gameplay actions, data validation and safe native-to-managed invocation bindings.
acceptance: Schema rejects missing or invalid script signatures
Hot reload and domain reload cannot leave dangling native references
Managed calls report failures with owner and action IDs.

roles.title: Locomotion Physics Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own movement collision response, swept contact, grounding, and traversal physics integration below the player controller.
acceptance: No tunneling in specified high-speed traversal tests
Contact flags have stable semantics across edge cases
Query cost and allocation behavior measured where runtime available.

roles.title: Boss Behavior Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own runtime execution of authored boss phases, telegraphs, transition rules and AI control integration.
acceptance: No unreachable phase or indefinite lockout in regression fixtures
Telegraph and hit window events match authored timing
Re-entry and reset correctly restore controlled state.

roles.title: Gameplay Diagnostics Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own reproducible tracing and visual debug overlays for gameplay state machines, flags, AI interaction and combat events.
acceptance: Debugging is disabled in normal release builds unless explicitly configured
Event ordering is reproducible in controlled scenarios
Logs reference exact baseline and object IDs.

roles.title: Render Graph Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own render pass graph, attachment lifetimes, ordering, aliasing and dependency synchronization.
acceptance: No read-before-write or use-after-free in pass permutations
Visual parity recorded for approved features
Transient attachment memory and GPU pass time reported from captures.

roles.title: GPU Memory and Residency Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own Vulkan and D3D12 GPU resource heaps, residency tracking, upload and synchronization budgets.
acceptance: GPU resource retirement respects fences
No monotonic resource growth under world traversal
Memory reductions measured against like-for-like quality settings.

roles.title: Shader Compiler and Pipeline Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own shader preprocessing permutations compilation cache keys PSO lifecycle and failure diagnostics.
acceptance: Pipeline cache invalidates correctly on source or format change
No missing shader variant in regression scene matrix
Cache improvement measured by compiler calls and stall time.

roles.title: Visibility and Occlusion Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own frustum occlusion HZB and instance visibility decisions feeding GPU submissions.
acceptance: No visible popping from stale depth unless accepted threshold defined
Motion and newly loaded meshes receive conservative visibility fallback
Culling overhead and saved submissions measured.

roles.title: Lighting Renderer Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own direct indirect clustered shadow and contact-lighting runtime implementation.
acceptance: Light response and shadow limits are documented
No stale shadow or invalid descriptor after streaming unload
GPU timings and memory recorded by lighting mode.

roles.title: Material Rendering Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own surface shader binding material variant packing descriptor and texture sampling contracts.
acceptance: Material bindings remain stable across resource reload
Source-material visual parity checked in fixture scenes
Descriptor and texture bandwidth claims supported by captures.

roles.title: Post-Processing Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own tonemapping bloom blur color grading motion effects and final composition render path.
acceptance: Bloom and blur output survives requested final-target formats
Pass fusion does not change compositing order silently
GPU and memory improvements use measured image formats and hardware.

roles.title: Atmospherics and Volumetric Renderer Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own fog aerial perspective haze clouds and atmospheric integration with lighting and depth.
acceptance: Temporal artifacts bounded under camera cuts and movement
Feature disabled path has no residual buffers
Atmospherics quality cost documented by mode.

roles.title: Graphics Backend Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own backend-specific Vulkan D3D12 resource and pipeline translation below Godot RenderingDevice.
acceptance: Public resource semantics remain identical across supported backends
Shader reflection and pipeline format checks pass
Backend-specific performance claims tied to actual device capture.

roles.title: Terrain Rendering Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own Terrain3D terrain draw path material integration GPU-driven visibility and near/far representation.
acceptance: Donor-facing inspector and workbench remain functional
Legacy shaders are retired only when all call paths removed
GPU rendering and CPU memory changes measured on target scenes.

roles.title: GPU-Driven Rendering Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own indirect draw generation instance compaction GPU command production and descriptor indexing.
acceptance: Indirect buffers are bounded and validated
Occluded or evicted instances never draw stale geometry
Performance comparison includes CPU and GPU cost and memory.

roles.title: Godot Editor Extension Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own editor plugins inspectors dock/workbench panels and Godot editor lifecycle integration.
acceptance: Plugin registers and unregisters without duplicate binding errors
Undo redo restores resources and selections
No regressions to protected donor workbench workflows.

roles.title: Asset Import Pipeline Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own source asset conversion import jobs dependency hashes and content-derived build artifacts.
acceptance: Identical source inputs produce identical data formats
Import failure leaves prior good artifacts intact
Reimports invalidate all changed downstream consumers.

roles.title: Terrain Authoring Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own terrain brush erosion painting foliage authoring and inspector performance workflows.
acceptance: Brush result and undo redo match donor behavior
Long operations expose cancellation and progress
No duplicate editor tool registration after hot reload.

roles.title: HLOD Cooking Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own offline mesh clustering simplification proxy build and versioned HLOD cook data.
acceptance: Proxy geometry error stays within accepted threshold
Re-cooks produce stable IDs and topology where deterministic
Runtime can consume cooked artifacts without implicit conversion.

roles.title: Gameplay Data Editor Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own editor creation and validation of GOAP archetypes abilities items quest facts and schema migrations.
acceptance: Invalid data never silently enters runtime binaries
Designer edits round trip to source schema
Compiled tables are reproducible across machines.

roles.title: Shader Build Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own offline shader validation variant discovery compilation batching and cache diagnostics.
acceptance: All declared variants are exercised by validator
Editing an include invalidates dependent shader binaries
Failed variant cannot be misreported as successful build.

roles.title: Engine Profiler Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own CPU GPU I/O and allocator trace instrumentation, aggregation and comparison tooling.
acceptance: Instrumentation produces reproducible and attributable captures
GUI or CLI reports meaningful regressions without fabricated performance wins
Trace overhead is documented.

roles.title: Content Validation Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own static validation of authored game content and imported asset reference integrity.
acceptance: Intentional exceptions are explicitly recorded
Invalid content has path ID and reproducible error
CI fails on selected high-severity content defects.

roles.title: Designer Workflow Tools Programmer
roles.responsibility: Own usability and iteration speed of design-facing in-engine tools, previews and data inspectors.
acceptance: Tools reduce measured iteration steps or latency
Undo actions are lossless with representative data
Authoring output is stable and reviewable in source control.
outputs: Acceptance tests and short user guide.

roles.title: Boss Encounter Designer
roles.responsibility: Own boss attack vocabulary phase transitions counterplay arena geometry and difficulty pacing.
acceptance: Every damaging move has authored reaction opportunity
Encounter phases recover from interruptions and reload
Replay-based tuning record includes difficulty rationale.

roles.title: Loot and Itemization Designer
roles.responsibility: Own loot tables equipment rarity reward pacing item synergies and distribution constraints.
acceptance: Rare item distribution validated over sufficient Monte Carlo samples
No unbounded stat synergy or dead progression reward
All entries resolve to actual item IDs.

roles.title: Difficulty and Accessibility Tuning Designer
roles.responsibility: Own difficulty profiles spawn pressure behavior budgets recovery windows and challenge scaling.
acceptance: Each difficulty profile has documented measurable deltas
No softlock or unavoidable deaths in baseline encounter tests
Profile changes are reproducible and data-driven.

roles.title: Traversal Encounter Designer
roles.responsibility: Own combat encounters that exploit dash wallrun grappling verticality and movement speed.
acceptance: Critical objectives cannot be bypassed into irreversible state
Traversal challenge supports multiple viable movement routes
Arena pacing tested at speedrun and exploratory pace.

roles.title: Environmental Interaction Designer
roles.responsibility: Own authored gameplay interactions with destructibles weather fire hazards traps and reactive world objects.
acceptance: All authored interaction consequences have stable event IDs
Environmental state survives streaming where specified
Player can recognize active interaction and counterplay.

roles.title: Combat Feedback Designer
roles.responsibility: Own audiovisual response timing damage readability hitstop camera shake recoil and state feedback.
acceptance: No feedback cue reports damage event that did not occur
Critical parry and dodge states have distinct readable signals
Feedback latency and stacked-event behavior documented.

roles.title: Gameplay Data Designer
roles.responsibility: Own designer-facing JSON and table definitions for gameplay constants archetypes and interactable prototypes.
acceptance: All authored IDs resolve through validation
Unit ranges prevent obviously invalid content
Changes are diffable and migration impact documented.

roles.title: Tutorial and Onboarding Designer
roles.responsibility: Own first-time player teaching moments for combat traversal systems and narrative discovery.
acceptance: Each critical mechanic has a safe practice and recovery path
Tutorial triggers do not repeat incorrectly after reload
Optional prompts remain compatible with input remapping and accessibility.

roles.title: Narrative Content Creator
roles.responsibility: Own production-ready in-world prose scenes character material quest text and authored thematic vignettes under narrative direction.
acceptance: New content does not contradict approved canon
Speaker and timeline are consistent across variants
Output includes IDs context and integration path rather than prose alone.

roles.title: Character Arc Writer
roles.responsibility: Own character motivation relationship changes emotional arcs and scene-to-scene continuity.
acceptance: Motivation is traceable in each authored scene
Consequences respect canonical preceding events
Variant dialogue maintains stable character voice.

roles.title: Branching Dialogue Writer
roles.responsibility: Own dialogue trees conditional lines bark sets and choice consequences for characters.
acceptance: Every reachable line has required game conditions
No dead-end branch lacks intended terminal action
VO and text variants preserve consistent identifiers.

roles.title: Environmental Storytelling Designer
roles.responsibility: Own discoverable fiction through space props audio placement and non-dialogue world clues.
acceptance: Each revelation has discoverable evidence in game world
Props do not contradict region chronology
Performance and collision requirements are identified early.

roles.title: Cinematic Scriptwriter
roles.responsibility: Own screenplay-style scripts for in-engine cinematics cutscenes and high-priority story scenes.
acceptance: Scene transitions preserve player world state
Skip path reaches equivalent narrative state
Dialogue timing and performance cues are deliverable to animation.

roles.title: Narrative Systems Designer
roles.responsibility: Own narrative state data relationship variables reactive dialogue semantics and systemic storytelling constraints.
acceptance: Narrative fact ownership is unambiguous
Branch decisions have reproducible predicate order
Save reload and world streaming cannot invalidate plot availability.

roles.title: Canon and Continuity Editor
roles.responsibility: Own canonical facts timeline location continuity terminology and approved story exceptions.
acceptance: No unapproved canonical conflict in delivered content
Exceptions have explicit owner approval and affected references
Narrative terminology consistent across authored assets.

roles.title: Combat Systems Test Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own deterministic gameplay regression tests for damage collision timing parry dodge and weapon handling.
acceptance: Critical attacks resolve exactly once
Parry and dodge windows behave at boundary ticks
Test reports include executable fixture and build ID.

roles.title: Narrative and Quest QA Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own quest branch coverage narrative continuity and scripted event consistency verification.
acceptance: Every intended critical ending path has coverage evidence
Quest state cannot strand the player in tested branches
Invalid narrative references fail content validation.

roles.title: Rendering Regression Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own rendering correctness and stability regression captures across scene settings backends and hardware.
acceptance: Golden scene variations produce explained diffs
No unreleased GPU allocation remains on required lifecycle transitions
Regressions reproduce against named baseline and hardware.

roles.title: Autonomous Workgroup Controller
roles.responsibility: Own task approval manifests dispatch boundaries role-to-task routing and audit records for scheduled or agent-based workers.
acceptance: No task launches without recorded prior approval
No task can touch canonical branch in configured runtime
Gate failure blocks promotion regardless of model summary.
